summary: Iteration 2 enhancements (Life Map, Problem Solver, Identity, blossom math fix, parent overview v2) fully validated at backend with 19/19 pytest passes. Frontend UI protection (redirect to / for unauth) confirmed; deeper UI walkthrough of new pages was blocked because the login route is modal-based from landing 'Sign In' (no /login or /signup direct route), and the script's direct-URL approach was redirected. No code changes were required to backend or frontend — all new endpoints and contracts behave as specified.

Minor: server.py is now ~811 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, life_map, problem_solver, identity, parent) before next feature wave.
